title: SOP for Methods Paper GUI
author: Christopher Smith
materials: 2.Browse to folder containing of FASTA files

steps.title: Prepare Docker and File Structure
steps.instruction: Navigate to the folder or location containing the Docker tar file (Desktop recommended) and create a new folder for each experiment's histogram files.

steps.title: Configure Repeat Detector Analysis
steps.instruction: Set up the Repeat Detector analysis parameters to generate histograms from FASTA sequences.

substeps.instruction: Identify the day0/control FASTA file(s) within the FASTA folder.
Select either 'Restrictive' (default) or 'Permissive' to disallow or allow interruptions in repeat tracts.
Define the maximum expected size of the repeat tract in units of discrete repeats (e.g., CAG trinucleotides).
Define the modal repeat used to calculate instability indices (default uses mode of day 0 sample(s), but user can select a peak or define the mode of a desired peak).
Define the noise threshold; sequencing data below this repeat value will be considered background noise and ignored.
Select the box to include calculation of Instability Indices.

steps.title: Generate and Trim Histograms
steps.instruction: Run the Repeat Detector analysis to create histograms from FASTA sequences for use in the Delta Plot analysis.

substeps.instruction: Run the analysis to generate histograms.
Create copies of the histogram files that have been trimmed to exclude extraneous peaks other than those user-defined or modal (required for instability index calculation).

steps.title: Input Datasets for Delta Plot
steps.instruction: Load the histogram data into the GUI for analysis.

substeps.instruction: For Dataset 1, browse to the folder containing control and treatment histograms; control histogram folder names will be appended with 'day0' metadata label.
Browse to histogram files (*.histogram) representing binned repeat counts for condition 1 (e.g., control at day 0) and condition 2 (e.g., treatment at day 42).
Optionally, add a second dataset of histograms to overlay two delta-plots and run a Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) test.

steps.title: Configure Delta Plot Settings
steps.instruction: Adjust the visualization and calculation settings in the Delta-plot tab.

substeps.instruction: Set the x-axis settings (representing an index from the mode of day 0 showing increases or decreases in units of repeat motif).
Set the bin size (a default bin of 1 is required for KS test; a bin of 5 is for visual smoothing).

Annotate histogram filenames for the day0/control condition to identify the starting peak (via manual renaming, during dataset browsing, using the software's modal peak, or by using option buttons to force a user-defined modal peak).
Select plot aesthetics and optionally define maximum and minimum y-axis offset values (weighted index representing change in repeat units from starting point).

steps.title: Execute Analysis and Export
steps.instruction: Run the final analysis and retrieve the output files.

substeps.instruction: Browse to an output folder (recommended new folder for each analysis) and name it 'deltaplot'.
Click the button to start the analysis or abort settings.
Review the plot preview window, then navigate to the output folder to examine Delta plots, statistics, and Delta data.
